posts.title: Rarity tiers and cognitive load
posts.description: Rarity tiers in games where you choose often, like in a VS-like, are more about decreasing cognitive load for the player than anything else. The player just wants to choose whatever will make him more powerful, these games often do not have clearly explained systems where you can truly understand what all stats do, so the notion of a player deeply analyzing his 3-4 choices every half minute is not
